newsitem.title: USA: Lexington B & L seeks to buy 50,600 shares.
newsitem.headline: Lexington B & L seeks to buy 50,600 shares.

text.p: Lexington B & L Financial Corp said Tuesday it will seek to repurchase 50,600 shares of its common stock to fund the corporation's 1996 Management Recognition and Development Plan.
The plan was approved by shareholders on January 27, 1997.

The shares to be acquired in connection with the funding of the plan are in addition to Lexington's repurchase program announced on March 12, 1997 covering up to 126,500 shares of the corporation's common stock.

Lexington has authorized the Management Recognition and Develop Plan trust to make repurchases from time to time in open market conditions over the next six months. It is expected the plan awards will be made to eligible directors, officers and employees when the Management Development and Development Plan becomes effective on June 6.
